name: 合同（服务/价格/条款）生成

map.服务/价格/条款: Generate sample contract clauses and pricing text in batches by quantity, supporting first-draft contracts and clause-template tidying.
map.📖 查看「合同（服务/价格/条款）生成使用指南」: 📖 View the "Service Contract & Pricing Generator Guide"
map.小计 = 单价 × 数量；折扣额 = 小计 × 折扣率；含税价 = (小计 −: Subtotal = unit price × quantity; discount = subtotal × discount rate; taxed = (subtotal − discount) × (1 + tax rate); contract total = taxed rounded to cents; deposit = total × 30% rounded to cents; balance = total − deposit; penalty = total × 10% rounded to cents. The order is fixed: apply the discount first, then tax; discount and tax rates are entered as percentages.
map.起草服务合同时批量生成条款与报价样例，作为初稿再逐条修改。: When drafting a service contract, generate clauses and pricing samples in batches as a first draft, then edit them item by item.
map.时，用生成的样例补充常见条款措辞。: , use the generated samples to supplement common clause wording.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面按「单价 × 数量 → 折扣 → 税」算出合同总额、预付款: Set the count to 5; the page computes the contract total, deposit, balance and penalty by "unit price × quantity → discount → tax", then inserts those amounts into the service-clause drafts (service items rotate through the built-in list), ready to use as a quotation skeleton.
map.生成数量需为 1–50 的整数，超出范围会直接提示输入有误，不再按边界静默夹取；: The generation count must be an integer from 1 to 50; out-of-range values trigger an input error instead of being silently clamped. For more entries, generate in several batches and merge them.
map.生成的内容能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated content be used as a contract directly?
map.不能。生成的是措辞样例，条款效力、金额与权责需由双方确认并经法务审核，正式合同请: No. What is generated is sample wording; clause validity, amounts and responsibilities must be confirmed by both parties and reviewed by legal, and the approved version governs the formal contract.
map.按服务内容、价格与关键条款生成规范合同草稿: Generate a standard contract draft from the service scope, price and key clauses
map.家政与劳务协议快速起草: Drafting domestic-service and labour agreements quickly
map.服务范围与价格条款固化留存: Keeping the service scope and price clauses on file
map.给客户做报价前先生成几版不同生成数量的合同草案，供内部讨论取舍。: Before quoting a client, generate several contract drafts with different generation counts for internal discussion.
map.设定生成数量 5，页面按内置服务项（网站开发、品牌策划、法律咨询等）固定顺序循环: Set the quantity to 5; the page cycles through the built-in service items (website development, brand planning, legal consulting and so on) in a fixed order and generates quote entries with service content, quantity and amounts in Chinese uppercase numerals, ready to serve as a quote skeleton.
map.不会。生成与合同条款组合全部在浏览器本地完成，服务端不接收任何输入。: No. Generation and contract-clause assembly happen entirely in your browser; the server receives no input.
map.当前按输入金额与固定顺序生成合同草案，服务项按内置列表循环使用；暂不支持锁定指定: Drafts are generated from the entered amounts in a fixed order, with service items cycling through the built-in list. Specific clauses cannot be locked yet; generate first, then adjust manually as needed.
map.输入单价、数量、税率与: Enter unit price, quantity, tax rate and
map.后生成草案：先计算小计并打折，再计税，按分四舍五入得合同总额，并计算预付款、尾款: then generate a draft: the subtotal is calculated and discounted first, tax is applied, the result is rounded to cents for the contract total, and the prepayment, balance and penalty are computed. Service items are chosen from a built-in list.
map.生成数量须为 1–50 的整数，超出范围会提示输入有误；需要更多条目可分次生成后: The number of items must be an integer from 1 to 50; values outside this range trigger an input error. For more items, generate several batches and merge them.
map.，同一批内不重复；正式归档请自行填写并按贵司编号规则确认，本工具不承诺跨设备/跨: , unique within one batch; for formal filing, fill in your own number under your company rule. This tool does not promise global uniqueness across devices or sessions.
